issuePathNote: Each refused case gives issuePath, the path of the field that the schema refuses. A rule that spans fields is refused at the field that breaks it: the later one of a repeated name or symbol, or the whole list of reads for a scope consumer. Only the Bun test checks the path: the host's parser returns an error with no field path.

manifest.name: github_pull_request
manifest.schema:
CREATE TABLE "github_pull_request" (
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "number" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "repository_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "title" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "state" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "is_draft" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "is_merged" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "author_id" TEXT,
  "url" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "merge_commit_sha" TEXT,
  "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "closed_at" TEXT,
  "merged_at" TEXT,
  "payload" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);

CREATE INDEX "github_pull_request_repository_id_idx" ON "github_pull_request" ("repository_id");

CREATE TABLE "github_pull_request_alias" (
  "alias" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("alias")
);

CREATE INDEX "github_pull_request_alias_entity_id_idx" ON "github_pull_request_alias" ("entity_id");

CREATE TABLE "github_release_bump" (
  "pull_request_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "release_repository" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "release_tag" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("pull_request_id", "release_repository", "release_tag")
);

CREATE INDEX "github_release_bump_release_repository_release_tag_idx" ON "github_release_bump" ("release_repository", "release_tag");

CREATE VIEW "entity" AS
SELECT
  "id" AS "id",
  'github:pull_request' AS "kind",
  "title" AS "title",
  "url" AS "url",
  "author_id" AS "actor",
  "updated_at" AS "updated_at"
FROM "github_pull_request";

manifest.name: github_release

CREATE TABLE "github_release" (
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "repository_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "repository_full_name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "tag_name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "target_commitish" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "url" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "is_draft" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "is_prerelease" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "published_at" TEXT,
  "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);

CREATE INDEX "github_release_repository_id_idx" ON "github_release" ("repository_id");

CREATE INDEX "github_release_repository_full_name_tag_name_idx" ON "github_release" ("repository_full_name", "tag_name");

CREATE VIEW "entity" AS
SELECT
  "id" AS "id",
  'github:release' AS "kind",
  "name" AS "title",
  "url" AS "url",
  NULL AS "actor",
  "updated_at" AS "updated_at"
FROM "github_release"
WHERE "deleted_at" IS NULL;

CREATE TABLE "ledger_account" (
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT,
  "balance" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "is_closed" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "opened_at" TEXT,
  "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);

CREATE TABLE "ledger_entry" (
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "rate" REAL NOT NULL,
  "memo" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "details" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "posted_at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);

CREATE INDEX "ledger_entry_account_id_idx" ON "ledger_entry" ("account_id");

CREATE VIEW "entity" AS
SELECT
  "id" AS "id",
  'ledger:account' AS "kind",
  "name" AS "title",
  NULL AS "url",
  NULL AS "actor",
  "updated_at" AS "updated_at"
FROM "ledger_account"
UNION ALL
SELECT
  "id" AS "id",
  'ledger:entry' AS "kind",
  "memo" AS "title",
  NULL AS "url",
  NULL AS "actor",
  "posted_at" AS "updated_at"
FROM "ledger_entry";
